title: the usage has one row per command that came after the first port
source: intended: every command is listed in the usage with a summary
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-21, version). The oracle usage has no `version` row, so the row expectation FAILS on TS. Each later command adds its own word to the for_each list (install, defect N-16, and setup, defect N-17: those usage rows appear only in the Go CLI). The second step pins the final summary of the `build` row, `list, validate, create, draft, save and discard builds` (defects N-13, N-14, N-15); the oracle has no `build` row.

stdout.regex: (?m)^  build +list, validate, create, draft, save and discard builds$
